#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <deque>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
const long long INF = (long long)1e18 + 1;

class Solver {
private:
    long long binomial[100][100];
    
    long long compute(long long base, int n1, int r1, int n2, int r2) {
        base = (base * binomial[n1][r1]) % MOD;
        base = (base * binomial[n2][r2]) % MOD;
        return base;
    }
    
public:
    void execute(int testId, int N, int K, vector<int>& values) {
        int cnt50 = 0, cnt100 = 0;
        for (int val : values) {
            if (val == 50) cnt50++;
            else cnt100++;
        }
        
        // Build binomial table
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            binomial[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                binomial[i][j] = (binomial[i-1][j] + binomial[i-1][j-1]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        long long distance[200][200][2];
        long long ways[200][200][2];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++) {
                distance[i][j][0] = INF;
                distance[i][j][1] = INF;
                ways[i][j][0] = 0;
                ways[i][j][1] = 0;
            }
        }
        
        distance[0][0][0] = 0;
        ways[0][0][0] = 1;
        
        struct Node {
            int a, b, side;
            long long dist;
            Node(int a_, int b_, int side_, long long dist_) : a(a_), b(b_), side(side_), dist(dist_) {}
        };
        
        deque<Node> queue;
        queue.push_back(Node(0, 0, 0, 0));
        
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            Node node = queue.front();
            queue.pop_front();
            int a = node.a;
            int b = node.b;
            int side = node.side;
            long long d = distance[a][b][side];
            
            if (side == 0) {
                int left50 = cnt50 - a;
                int left100 = cnt100 - b;
                for (int take50 = 0; take50 <= left50; take50++) {
                    for (int take100 = 0; take100 <= left100; take100++) {
                        if (take50 == 0 && take100 == 0) continue;
                        int weight = take50 * 50 + take100 * 100;
                        if (weight > K) break;
                        int na = a + take50;
                        int nb = b + take100;
                        int nextSide = side ^ 1;
                        if (distance[na][nb][nextSide] >= d + 1) {
                            if (distance[na][nb][nextSide] > d + 1) {
                                distance[na][nb][nextSide] = d + 1;
                                queue.push_back(Node(na, nb, nextSide, d + 1));
                                ways[na][nb][nextSide] = (ways[na][nb][nextSide] + compute(ways[a][b][side], left50, take50, left100, take100)) % MOD;
                            } else {
                                ways[na][nb][nextSide] = (ways[na][nb][nextSide] + compute(ways[a][b][side], left50, take50, left100, take100)) % MOD;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                int left50 = a;
                int left100 = b;
                for (int take50 = 0; take50 <= left50; take50++) {
                    for (int take100 = 0; take100 <= left100; take100++) {
                        if (take50 == 0 && take100 == 0) continue;
                        int weight = take50 * 50 + take100 * 100;
                        if (weight > K) break;
                        int na = a - take50;
                        int nb = b - take100;
                        int nextSide = side ^ 1;
                        if (distance[na][nb][nextSide] >= d + 1) {
                            if (distance[na][nb][nextSide] > d + 1) {
                                distance[na][nb][nextSide] = d + 1;
                                queue.push_back(Node(na, nb, nextSide, d + 1));
                                ways[na][nb][nextSide] = (ways[na][nb][nextSide] + compute(ways[a][b][side], left50, take50, left100, take100)) % MOD;
                            } else {
                                ways[na][nb][nextSide] = (ways[na][nb][nextSide] + compute(ways[a][b][side], left50, take50, left100, take100)) % MOD;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (distance[cnt50][cnt100][1] == INF) {
            cout << -1 << endl;
        } else {
            cout << distance[cnt50][cnt100][1] << endl;
        }
        cout << ways[cnt50][cnt100][1] << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int N, K;
    cin >> N >> K;
    
    vector<int> values(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        cin >> values[i];
    }
    
    Solver s;
    s.execute(1, N, K, values);
    
    return 0;
}
